hero.standfirst: Find a programme that fits your needs, with doctor-guided care, prescribed meals and time to rest in the gardens of Kairali, Palakkad.

faq.q: Which Ayurveda programme should I choose?
faq.a: Start with the reason you are seeking care, rather than a package name alone. Explore the programmes on this page, then discuss your health history, goals and current treatment with an Ayurvedic doctor. The assessment helps determine suitable therapies and duration, so you can plan your stay with a clearer understanding.

faq.q: Is the initial doctor consultation free?
faq.a: Yes. Your initial doctor consultation is free. Share your health history, current medicines and goals, and ask whether a stay may suit you. This does not make treatment, tests, medicines or later consultations free. Ask the team to explain the charges that apply before you book.

faq.q: How long should I stay at Kairali?
faq.a: The recommended stay depends on your programme and individual assessment. Each programme has its own minimum duration; there is no single length that suits everyone. Tell the doctor how much time you have before making travel plans, and confirm the recommended number of nights with our team.

faq.q: What determines the cost of my stay?
faq.a: Your quotation depends on the programme, length of stay, travel dates and villa occupancy. Ask for a breakdown of the included care and extras, including medicines, tests, specialist therapies, private sessions and transport. Review the full plan with our team before you confirm your booking.

faq.q: What is included in a care package?
faq.a: Care packages include villa stay and taxes, three prescribed vegetarian or vegan meals, daily doctor review, group yoga and meditation, prescribed therapies, weekly activities and leisure facilities. The number of therapies depends on the programme. Medicines, tests and several personal or specialist services cost extra; confirm the full inclusions in your quotation.

faq.q: What should I arrange before travelling?
faq.a: Speak with the doctor about your health and the time you can set aside, then confirm your programme, dates and accommodation. Tell our team if you need help with airport transfers or have questions about access. Bring your medical records and current medicine details to the consultation.

## Inpatient Care in Villas at Kerala's Ayurvedic Retreat

Stay at Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village in Palakkad, Kerala, with Ayurvedic care and villa accommodation in a garden setting. Programme inclusions and minimum stays vary. Ask our team for a quotation for your recommended programme and dates.

### Deluxe Villa

Comfortable villa accommodation in the village gardens, with air conditioning, a telephone, bath and shower.

### Classic Villa

A villa surrounded by the village gardens, with space to sit and rest between appointments.

### Royal Villa

Villa accommodation with comfortable interiors and room to relax during your prescribed programme.

### Maharaja Suite

A spacious suite with a king-size bed and a private lawn. Ask patient care about its layout and availability.

### What your care package includes

Villa stay and taxes; three prescribed vegetarian or vegan meals; daily doctor review; group yoga and meditation; prescribed therapies (normally two daily; one in the Preventive Health & Regenerative programme); weekly activities and leisure facilities.

Charged separately:

medicines, tests, specialist therapies, extra food, private sessions, laundry, telephone, internet, transport and early check-in/late check-out. Programme rates and minimum stays vary.

## Explore Palakkad

## Explore Palakkad

Thiruvalathoor

It is a peaceful village in Kerala's Palakkad district that is rich in culture and spirituality. It is home to the historic Thiruvalathoor Mahadeva Temple, a famous shrine to Lord Shiva. The temple, known for its beautiful wooden carvings and traditional Kerala-style architecture, attracts both devout and architecture aficionados visiting nearby ayurvedic treatment packages in Kerala retreats. Thiruvalathoor, surrounded by thick greenery, has a serene ambiance that makes it an ideal location for spiritual searchers and nature enthusiasts.

Distance from Kairali - The Ayurvedic Healing Village: 5.2 km

Kathakali

Kathakali is an ancient classical dance drama that depicts an act of devotion and the universal conflict between good and evil. With years of pedagogy, the dance form uses choreography, face, and hand movements to express Indian folklore and is often showcased to guests staying at the healing Village in Kerala, India.

Thenari

Thenari is a lovely village in Kerala's Palakkad district that is well-known for its natural beauty and cultural significance. The town is famous for the Thenari Natural Spring, a sacred location with divine origins and ties to the Ramayana. Surrounded by rich greenery and quiet scenery, it is a peaceful getaway for those seeking spiritual serenity and a connection with nature while enjoying Kerala ayurvedic treatment stays. Its tranquil surroundings and historical significance make it a hidden gem among Kerala's rich cultural legacy.

Distance from Kairali - The Ayurvedic Healing Village: 10 km

Mohiniyattam

The classical dance form of Kerala, Mohiniyattam, finds its roots in Hindu Mythology. The undulating movements depict the dance of the enchantress Mohini. She made demons fall for her oscillating dance steps, passionate eyes, and graceful gestures to restore elixir. A delight for your eyes, women adorn simple, elegant gold-filigreed dresses in pure white or ivory while performing, often presented as a cultural highlight for guests enjoying ayurvedic treatment packages in Kerala at this retreat.
